note: Hand-authored seed corpus encoding publicly documented eligibility rules for central schemes. Values are indicative and MUST be re-verified against the current scheme notification before any real-world use. The ingest pipeline (yogya.ingest.myscheme) overwrites this with a live snapshot.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 6,000 per year in three equal instalments, paid directly to the bank account of a landholding farmer family.
schemes.description: Income support to all landholding farmer families, subject to exclusion of higher-income and institutional categories.

criteria.description: The family must own cultivable land.
criteria.citation: PM-KISAN Operational Guidelines, cl. 3 (definition of farmer family)

criteria.description: At least one member must be engaged in cultivation.
No family member may have paid income tax in the last assessment year.
An Aadhaar-seeded bank account is required for direct benefit transfer.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.name_local: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
schemes.benefit_summary: Cashless hospitalisation cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
schemes.description: Health assurance for poor and vulnerable families identified through deprivation and occupational criteria.

criteria.description: The family must hold an Antyodaya or Priority Household ration card, or otherwise satisfy the deprivation criteria.
Income tax paying families are excluded.
criteria.citation: PM-JAY Beneficiary Identification Guidelines, exclusion list

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly old-age pension to persons aged 60 and above from below-poverty-line households; the central share is topped up by most states.
schemes.description: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme.

criteria.description: At least one member must be aged 60 or above.
The household must be below the poverty line.
A bank or post office account is required for pension credit.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly pension to widows aged 40 to 79 from below-poverty-line households.
schemes.description: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme.

criteria.description: The household must include a widow.
The household must be below the poverty line.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.benefit_summary: Monthly pension to persons with severe or multiple disability from below-poverty-line households.
schemes.description: Part of the National Social Assistance Programme.

criteria.description: The household must include a member with severe or multiple disability.
The household must be below the poverty line.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana — Gramin (PMAY-G)
schemes.benefit_summary: Assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh (plain areas) towards construction of a pucca house, plus MGNREGA labour days and a toilet grant.
schemes.description: Housing for all in rural areas, for households that are houseless or living in kutcha houses.

criteria.description: The household must reside in a rural area.
The household must be houseless or living in a kutcha or dilapidated house.
Income tax paying households are excluded.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.benefit_summary: Free LPG connection with deposit-free cylinder and first refill, plus a per-cylinder subsidy.
schemes.description: Clean cooking fuel for women from poor households.

criteria.description: The household must not already have an LPG connection.
The applicant must belong to a poor household as identified by the prescribed criteria.
A bank account is required for subsidy transfer.

schemes.name: National Food Security Act — Priority Household Entitlement
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
schemes.benefit_summary: 5 kg of subsidised foodgrain per person per month through the public distribution system.
schemes.description: Statutory food entitlement for priority households.

criteria.description: The household must hold a Priority Household or Antyodaya ration card.
Income tax paying households are excluded from priority status.
criteria.citation: State PDS exclusion norms under NFSA s. 10

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.benefit_summary: Maternity benefit of Rs 5,000 in instalments for the first living child, and Rs 6,000 for a second child if a girl.
schemes.description: Conditional cash transfer to partly compensate wage loss and support nutrition during pregnancy.

criteria.description: The household must include a pregnant or lactating woman.
A bank account in the beneficiary's own name is required.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.benefit_summary: Small savings account for a girl child with a high tax-free interest rate, maturing at age 21.
schemes.description: Long-term savings instrument to fund a girl child's education and marriage.

criteria.description: The household must include a girl child below 10 years of age.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at Rs 10,000, with interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.

criteria.description: At least one member must be a street vendor.
The vendor must operate in an urban or peri-urban area.
A bank account is required for loan disbursal.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.benefit_summary: Skill training with a stipend, a Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise loans for traditional artisans.
schemes.description: End-to-end support for artisans and craftspeople in eighteen traditional trades.

criteria.description: At least one member must work in a recognised traditional artisan trade.
The applicant artisan must be at least 18 years old.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 2 lakh life cover for an annual premium of Rs 436, auto-debited from the bank account.
schemes.description: Renewable one-year term life insurance for account holders aged 18 to 50.

criteria.description: A savings bank account with auto-debit consent is required.
At least one member must be between 18 and 50 years old.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 2 lakh accidental death and disability cover for an annual premium of Rs 20.
schemes.description: Accident insurance for bank account holders aged 18 to 70.

criteria.description: A savings bank account with auto-debit consent is required.
At least one member must be between 18 and 70 years old.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefit_summary: Annual scholarship and book grant for Scheduled Caste students in classes IX and X.
schemes.description: Reduces the drop-out rate at the pre-matric stage.

criteria.description: The household must include a school student.
The student must belong to a Scheduled Caste.
Parental annual income must not exceed Rs 2.5 lakh.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Other Backward Classes
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.benefit_summary: Maintenance allowance and reimbursement of course fees for OBC students in post-matriculation courses.
schemes.description: Supports continuation of education beyond class X.

criteria.description: The household must include a post-matric student.
The student must belong to an Other Backward Class.
Parental annual income must not exceed Rs 1.5 lakh.

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
schemes.benefit_summary: A legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per rural household per financial year.
schemes.description: Statutory right to unskilled manual work on demand, with an unemployment allowance if work is not provided.

criteria.description: The household must reside in a rural area.
The household must include an adult willing to do unskilled manual work.
